clauses.heading: PART III
clauses.content: PART III BENGALURU, WEDNESDAY , 01, APRIL, 2026 ( CHAITHRA, 11 , SHAKAVARSHA, 1948 ) No. 2 5 7 GREATER BENGALURU AUTHORITY BENGALURU CENTRAL CITY CORPORATION Office of the Commissioner, 10 th floor, PUB, MG road, Bengaluru-560001 No: Com/BCCC/PR/ 28 /26-27 Date:01-04-2026 NOTIFICATION The draft of the following bye-laws further to amend the Bengaluru City Corporation Building Bye-Laws, 2003 which the Bengaluru Central City Corporation proposes to make in exercise of the powers conferred by section 317 read with sections 224, 232, 233 and 241 of the Greater Bengaluru Governance Act, 2024 (Karnataka Act 36 of 2025), with approval of the Government is hereby published as required by sections 318(2) of the said Act, for the information of all persons likely to be affected thereby and notice is hereby given that the said draft will be taken into consideration after the expiry of thirty days from the date of its publication in the official Gazette. Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the Bengaluru Central City Corporation from any person with respect to the said draft before the expiry of thirty days period from the date of this notification will be considered by the Bengaluru Central City Corporation. Objections and suggestions may be addressed to the Commissioner, Bengaluru Central City Corporation, Office of the Commissioner, 10 th floor, PUB, MG road, Bengaluru-560001. DRAFT BYE-LAWS
